## Important: no `prototype/` folder

`c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\prototype` **does not exist**. The active demo is **`c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\`**. Docs and `project-memory.md` refer to this as the prototype.

---

## 1. Sheet / Inspector collapse–expand (table workbook pages)

### Pages with toggles (only 2)

| Page | Route | File |
|------|-------|------|
| 储量工作簿 | `/reserve/collection` | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\pages\Reserve\ReserveCollectionPage.vue` |
| 方案编制 (规划工作簿) | `/planning/workflow` | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\pages\Planning\PlanningSchemePage.vue` |

Other table-heavy pages (`ReserveHistoryCleaningPage`, `PlanningCollectionPage`, etc.) do **not** use this 3-pane workbook layout.

### Toggle mechanism

**State (both default to `false` = closed):**

```38:40:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\pages\Reserve\ReserveCollectionPage.vue
const inspectorOpen = ref(false)
const sheetNavOpen = ref(false)
const focusMode = ref(false)
```

**Buttons:**

```160:166:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\pages\Reserve\ReserveCollectionPage.vue
        <a-button size="small" @click="sheetNavOpen = !sheetNavOpen"><MenuFoldOutlined v-if="sheetNavOpen" /><MenuUnfoldOutlined v-else />{{ sheetNavOpen ? '收起 Sheet' : '展开 Sheet' }}</a-button>
        ...
        <a-button size="small" @click="inspectorOpen = !inspectorOpen">{{ inspectorOpen ? '收起检查器' : '展开检查器' }}</a-button>
        <a-button size="small" ... @click="focusMode = !focusMode">
```

**Layout binding (`v-if` + CSS classes):**

```170:212:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\pages\Reserve\ReserveCollectionPage.vue
    <section class="workbook-layout" :class="{ 'sidebar-collapsed': !sheetNavOpen, 'inspector-collapsed': !inspectorOpen, 'is-focus': focusMode }">
      <aside v-if="sheetNavOpen" class="workbook-sidebar">
        ...
      </aside>
      <main class="workbook-main">
        <vxe-table ... :height="focusMode ? 680 : 590">
      ...
      <aside v-if="inspectorOpen" class="inspector-panel business-inspector">
```

Identical pattern in `PlanningSchemePage.vue` (lines 43–45, 162–165, 173–210).

**CSS grid rules** — `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\styles\global.css`:

```472:554:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\styles\global.css
.workbook-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
  ...
}
.workbook-layout.inspector-collapsed {
  grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.workbook-layout.sidebar-collapsed {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
}
.workbook-layout.sidebar-collapsed.inspector-collapsed {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.workbook-layout.is-focus {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.workbook-layout.is-focus .workbook-sidebar {
  display: none;
}
.workbook-layout.is-focus .business-inspector {
  display: none;
}
```

**1280px / 1024px breakpoints** (same file ~971–1013) also reshape the grid and stack the inspector with `grid-column: 1 / -1`.

### Why it might feel “broken”

1. **Default closed by design** — `project-memory.md` V0.6: *“Sheet 导航、检查器、聚焦模式独立控制，默认优先展示主表”*. On load both panels are hidden; user must click “展开 Sheet” / “展开检查器”. This is intentional, not a missing handler.

2. **Focus mode overrides toggles** — `focusMode` adds `is-focus`, which `display: none`s sidebar and inspector via CSS **without** resetting `sheetNavOpen` / `inspectorOpen`. Buttons can still say “收起检查器” while the panel is invisible until focus mode is exited.

3. **1280px grid conflict** — At `max-width: 1280px`, base rule forces `grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr)` and inspector gets `grid-column: 1 / -1`. With sidebar closed and inspector open, the main table can land in the narrow 220px column before the inspector stacks below — layout can look wrong at that width.

4. **Fixed table height** — `vxe-table` uses hardcoded heights (590/610/680). Opening/closing panels changes grid width but **does not** trigger a table resize/reflow; table area may not expand to fill freed space.

5. **Workflow auto-opens inspector only** — `runValidation()`, `submitReview()`, `locateIssue()`, etc. set `inspectorOpen = true`, but manual toggles start from closed. No persistence across navigation.

6. **No JS errors in toggle logic** — toggles are inline `@click` flips; no shared composable, no event wiring bugs found in source. Playwright snapshots (`.playwright-mcp/`) show buttons working (“收起 Sheet”, “展开检查器”) on 2026-07-10/11 runs.

## 2. Charts / ECharts inventory

**Single chart component:**  
`c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\components\charts\MetricTrendChart.vue`  
Uses `echarts.init()` + `setOption({ notMerge: true })`. Supports `line`, `bar`, and `pie` (`chartKind` prop).

**Complexity summary:**

| Complexity | Supported? | Used where? |
|------------|------------|-------------|
| Line + bar **combo in one chart** | Yes (per-series `type`) | **No page uses mixed line+bar together** |
| Multi-series comparison | Yes | Version pages, visualization pages |
| Multi-dimension (year × field × metric filters) | Partial (multi-select + multi-series) | `PlanningVisualizationPage`, `ReserveOutputPage`, `ReserveAnalysisPage` |
| Pie / donut | Yes | `ReserveAnalysisPage`, `PlanningOutputPage` |
| Dual-axis / stacked / drill-down | **No** | — |

### Pages with charts

| File | Route (active) | Chart complexity |
|------|----------------|------------------|
| `ReserveAnalysisPage.vue` | `/reserve/analysis` | **High** — metric filter, bar/line toggle, separate pie/bar/line “汇报图形”, multi-unit categories |
| `PlanningOutputPage.vue` | `/planning/output` | **High** — multi oilfield select, year segmented control, bar/line/pie switch |
| `PlanningVisualizationPage.vue` | Redirect → `/planning/output?focus=graphics` | **High** — multi oilfield + multi year, bar/line; **orphaned from router** |
| `ReserveOutputPage.vue` | Redirect → `/reserve/analysis?focus=graphics` | **High** — multi unit + multi metric (国家/内部/上市线); **orphaned from router** |
| `PlanningVersionPage.vue` | `/planning/version` | **Medium** — dual bar series V2 vs V3 by oilfield |
| `ReserveVersionPage.vue` | `/reserve/version` | **Medium** — dual line series baseline vs compare by unit |
| `PlanningCollectionPage.vue` | `/planning/collection` | **Medium** — multi-line (one series per oilfield × 3 years) |
| `PlanningProfilePage.vue` | `/planning/profile` | **Low** — 2 static line series (hardcoded data) |
| `PlanningHistoryPage.vue` | Redirect → `/planning/collection?focus=history` | **Medium** — multi-line by oilfield; **orphaned from router** |

**No charts on:** `DashboardPage`, workbook table pages, `AssistantPage`, `AdminPage`, `ReserveHistoryCleaningPage`.

**ECharts bundling:** `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\vite.config.ts` splits `echarts` into its own chunk.
